subject: Portal invite dead link after SSO redirect — Brightline onboarding
messages:
From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightline.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal invite dead link after SSO redirect

Hi Dylan / Monica,

We're trying to accept the supplier invite you sent for Brightline (Zip portal) but after clicking the "Accept" button and authenticating with our Okta SSO we land on a blank error page (503) that says "Redirect failed: invalid relay state". I've attached a screenshot (invite_deadlink_screenshot.png).

We need the vendor set up this week — there is a planned PO to be issued on Friday. Can you confirm whether you can reissue the invite or manually provision the vendor in Coupa while you investigate?

Details:
- Invite link received: https://zip.redwood.com/invite/abc123
- Our IdP: Brightline Okta (SAML)
- Contact for procurement: procurement@brightline.com

Thanks,
Sarah Lang
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Brightline Manufacturing

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightline.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal invite dead link after SSO redirect

Hi Sarah — thanks for the screenshot and the clear repro steps. Sorry for the disruption.

Short answer: we can manually stage the vendor in Coupa and also reissue an alternate invite that bypasses the relay state flow while our engineering team diagnoses the SAML handoff. To proceed I need two quick things:
1) Confirm the exact HubSpot record or Brightline vendor name (I see multiple entries). HubSpot ref helps us avoid duplicates.
2) If you can share the W9 (PDF) or PO contact we can pre-populate fields for Coupa.

I'll loop in Monica to run the redirect logs and open a ticket with the runtime team — putting SUP-4321 on it. Monica, can you capture the redirect and relaystate payload for that invite id (abc123) and check whether the relaystate exceeds 4k or contains url-unsafe characters?

Proposed immediate plan:
- Monica to investigate SSO redirect/logs (ETA 2–4 hours).
- I will stage a vendor placeholder in Coupa if Brightline confirms W9 and vendor legal name (ETA by EOD).
- If staging is insufficient we will issue a temporary token link for procurement to accept the invite manually.

Sarah — if acceptable, please send the W9 to this thread and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.com]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightline.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal invite dead link after SSO redirect

Dylan — I've pulled the gateway logs for invite id abc123. Initial observations:

- The redirect from /invite/abc123 issues a 302 to our SAML endpoint with relaystate parameter set. After Okta POST back we see a 400 on our side: "relaystate parsing error: invalid character at offset 1782".
- Looks like URL-encoded JSON metadata is being used as relaystate by the partner integration (Zip), which can push the parameter length beyond typical safe limits.
- I raised SUP-4321 and attached the raw relaystate dump to the ticket. Engineering flagged it as a likely relaystate truncation / unsafe-encoding edgecase.

Workarounds available now:
1) Reissue an invite that uses a short token relay (we can do this immediately).
2) Manual vendor staging in Coupa while we patch the relaystate handling (patch ETA 3–4 business days).

Dylan — I can generate the short-token invite, but I need the contact email you want on the invite (Sarah vs procurement@brightline.com). If we send to procurement@brightline.com we can avoid the display-name mismatch.

Attaching: link to internal ticket (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SUP-4321)

—Monica
Monica Patel
Platform Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

2) If you prefer, we can accept the invite address as procurement@brightline.com and provide a short-token link (Monica's option #1) so your team authenticates via Okta but we avoid the long relaystate encoding.

Either way, we want to keep the PO milestone on track. Please confirm which path you'd like and we'll action it.

Best,
